question: Ekikundi ky'abeshuri nibatebeekaniisa okukora ekintu eky'omutaano ekirikwetaga omuringo gw'amasannyalaze ogutabangaine. Ni engyenderwaho ki ehurikworeka eby'okukoresa ebirikwetagisa okukora omurimo gwabo?
answer_a: Ekyoma ky'okushomesereza, obupangisa, hamu n'omusheesho
answer_b: Tape y'omusharara, obucweka bw'amasanyalaze, n'obucweka bw'okukwata ebintu bicweeka
answer_c: Emikwa, obupangisa, hamwe n'ekyoma ky'okushomeereza
answer_d: Amagozi, ekyoma eky’okubambisa, n’ekyoma eky’okwaha waya

question: Shoma abeshomesa abegi bakwatirweho kukora omurimo gw'okumaraho oburemeezi bw'okutebeekanisa n'okushaanura ebikoreso (ensaabi, amapulayiizi, empima, enyondo, n'ebikoomi by'okutema) omu kicweka ky'eby'obuhangwa n'entunguka. Biki ebirungi ebi baine kuteekateekaaho ku barikukora ekintu/omumarizo gwabo?
answer_a: Ekiragira okuterekaho ebikoreso omu muringo ogurikukurirana n'obunene bwabyo, oburemezi bwabyo, n'emiterere yaabyo
answer_b: Ekiragira okuterekamu ebikoreso omu muringo ogurikworeka ngu nibyangu kworeka abakozesa
answer_c: Kikozirwe omu bintu ebirikubaasa kwemereza oburemeerezi kandi bikaremesa ebikoreso kutoba omu maizi
answer_d: Ekyakozesebwa ebintu eby'akaafu n'ekirikugumira empindahinduka y'obushuushu

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omugyezibwa naayenda abegi be ab'omwaka ogwa 7 kukora engano ezirikukwatanisa ezibasha kugabana na banywani baabo ab'omuishomero na abazaire. Webusayiti ki erikukirayo kwemerera kukora omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Scratch

question: Abeshomesha abarikwata ebibuuzo n'okuhuuza abantu omurundi gwa mbere n'ekigendererwa ky'okwetegyereza ebi barikwenda n'ebirikubagwisa, ekikorwa eki nikikwatana na kyi omubucweka bw'omushinga?
answer_a: Murikumiriza omukozesa
answer_b: Manyaaza omukoresa.
answer_c: Hamazya ebigendererwa
answer_d: Shwijuma omugasha ogu.

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omugisha gw'okwegyesa ogurikugyenda omu bintu bingi nigutebeekanisibwa hagati y'Eby'obuhangwa n'Okwegyesa Omubiri, ogurikugyenderera kwongyera okwetegyereza omuringo enkora y'enteerane y'enyama z'amagufa g'omubiri gw'omuntu erikukora.
Ni bintu ki eby'Eby'obuhangwa ebirikukwata aha mugisha ogu ebirikubaasa kukoresibwa omu mugisha ogu?
answer_a: Ebiragiro by'omubumbi nk'eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka omuringo ebinyabuzima by'omubiri birikukora n'omukago gwabyo n'amagufa.
answer_b: Emiringa y'amasannyalaze nk'eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka omuringo omukuraato gw'obwongo oguri ahagati n'oguri aha rubaju gukora.
answer_c: Okukoresa obundi n'okugaruramu ebintu omu kubangaanisa eby'okureeba eby'entebeekanisa y'amagufa n'enyama
answer_d: Omumaro gw'enteekateeka kworeka omukoranire hamwe hagati y'ebicweka by'omubiri n'amagufa

question: Omuhendo ki ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kubuuza abegi be kureeta obutaikirizana omu biteekateeko byabo, okurikukwata aha ku telefoni ekuzire nk'omuringo gw'okumaraho oburemeezi omu by'obuhangwa?
answer_a: Eizi mirimo ki ey'amaani esimu y'omulembe egiine ey'omutaano n'esimu ez'enyima?
answer_b: Eky'omutaano gw'essimu kikyendeeire kita omu bwire bw'okubaho kwagwo?
answer_c: Eshonga za 'simati' n'enkora y'omugasho rundi n'ekizibu omu by'obusingye?
answer_d: Ni nshonga ki ezirikumarwa omu bantu kurabira omu kureebeka kw'amasimu?

question: Shoma abeshomesa b'ekibiina kya Middle School nibatebeekanisiza orugyendo rw'aha muheru gw'omwaka, ahabw'ekyo nibashwijuma engyenderwaho z'eby'entambura ezihariho. Baine ebiciimo bingi kuruga omu makampani agariho, kwonka bataine bwengye kandi tibarikumanya ebi baraabe nibatekateeka kugira ngu bacwe orubanja. Omusomesa waabo omukuru naagira ngu batware okushoborora oku omu kibiina ky'Eby'obuhangwa n'Etekнология, nukwo babishoborore omu bwiire bw'ebirikukoresibwa kushwijuma emirimo. Omu mbeera egi, niki ekirikukoresibwa ekishemereire kubanza kukoresibwa omu kushwijuma engyenderwaho kugira ngu bacwe orubanja orikukwata aha murimo gw'eby'entambura ogurikukirayo oburungi?
answer_a: Shaba omugisha gw'okukora orugyendo rw'okugezesa kandi ohamye ngu byoona nibikora omu muringo ogurikwetagisa.
answer_b: Kuratira omusingi gw'eby'enfuna, orikukurira omuhendo gwabo n'ebiciingo ebirikuhairwa.
answer_c: Shaba eky’amateeka, okukakasa ngu eky’entambura hamu n’omushhoferi byombi birimu ebihandiiko ebiriyo.
answer_d: Kuratunga omuhendo gw'okumarwa g'abakiriya, orikukoresa internet kushaka ebyahingwireho nari okwemereza ebirikubaasa kureetwa n'abakiriya.

question: Omugasho gw'okubanza omwegyesa ashemereire kutebeekanisa abegyi be omu kiraasi erimu omulingo gw'okwega okurikukwata aha mishonga niki?
answer_a: Yoreke omuhanda gw'okubuuza ekibuuzo ekirikugyendera hamwe n'okukicungura.
answer_b: Shobora ebigendererwa by'okwega n'ebirikurugamu.
answer_c: Kora no nondeeka y'eby'omulembe ebiriho omu mishinga etariisha
answer_d: Yebemberize abeshomesa omu bice by’okushoma ebi abeeshoma batakahuliiremu.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurataho: Abanywani b'ekicweka ky'eby'oburezi tibashoma ebipande nari ebipande by'okumanyisa ebi ebirimu amakuru agumire ahari bo, ahabw'enshonga egi, obwire n'obugagga nibitwarwa busha kukwatanisa amakuru emirundi mingi. Omu By'oburezi bw'Etekнология, ekibiina ky'abanyeshuri nikichwekyerezibwa kwemereza ekizibu eki omu ishomero ryabo kandi bateekateeka ekikorwa ky'etekнология kukimaraaho. Nibatandika kutebeza ebicweka bitarikushushana by'omuringo gw'enteekateeka y'omushinga; omu kimwe ahari byo, nibata omutima aha kucweeka ebintu bitarikushushana ebirikukoresibwa omu kuhandiika. Omurundi ogu gw'omuringo gw'enteekateeka y'omushinga ogu omurimo ogu guri kwenda?
answer_a: Okushaka amakuru, bwanyima y'okumanya ekyetengo
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa eby'okukora omuhanda kurugiirira aha bi Eby'okushamuura byayoreka
answer_c: Okumanyisa Ebihangwa by'Eky'Okuhanga
answer_d: Okugyeragura eby'okugarukamu n'okukora etest y'omukozi

question: Abeshomesha abarikwenda kumara omurimo gwabo ogwa buri sande nibahereza ekicweka ky'ebyakozirwe. Ku barikumara, nibahereza ekicweka kya Gantt aha musomesa, omubo nibateeka emirimo eyabaheebwa buri omwe omu kubaho kw'omurimo. Abeshomesha aba bari aha ky'omurimo ki?
answer_a: Okugyeragyeranisa
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa
answer_c: Okuteekateeka ebitekerezo
answer_d: Kuhikiiriza

question: Abeshomesha abarikwega omugasho nibakora omurimo, nibaruka kuruga omu biteekateeko nibataaya omu kukora, nibareka enyima "omuringo" ogurikubaasa kwemeza obusingye. Omuringo ogu gwine ebiceera bingi, kandi gurimu ekicweka kimwe ekikuru omu kushoborora gye n'okucweekereza omurimo ogwo. Eky'okushoborora eki nikikwatana na kicweka ki?
answer_a: Omugane gwa Gantt, ogurikworeka ebicuucuura ebitari bimwe eby'okutebeekanisa okuhikire
answer_b: Okuteekateeka hamwe, ekurikukwasa kworeka ebishoborozi ebirikubaasa kuruga omu mitwarize etari emwe.
answer_c: Ahabwe ky'okukora, ahu ekirikukorwa kirikushobororwa
answer_d: Kushushaniika eky'okumaruruura, ekirikukwemerera kukiikirira eky'okumaruruura n'okuhameza yaaba okukikora nikibaasika

question: Shoma abeshomesa abari omu mwaka gwa ikumi na ibiri bakazoora oburemeezi omu ishomero ryabo: tihariho omuringo murungi ogw’okugura eby’okurya omu bunaku bw’okuhemera. Okugarukamu, bakatebeekaniza okutandika akaduuka akaguza ebibala na yogyati, abegi abarikukareebereza. Niki ekishomo eki barikubaasa kukoragana nakyo omu muringo gw’okuhiganira omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Omu by'okureeba, okuhwereera hamu n'obwengye bw'okukora ebishushani eby'okworeka omu kutunga akakubo k'okubamanyisa.
answer_b: Omuhanda gw'okukoresa Okubara, okukora okucweeka kw'emitindo y'okumanya abeeshure abarikukunda eby'okurya birungi omu mubiri
answer_c: N'ebya Biology, okushwijuma ebiri omu by'okurya ebi batunda n'amaani gabyo.
answer_d: N'eby'omubiri, okuhwerekyereza aha mutwe gw'ensonga y'eby'okurya ebirungi n'okukora emirimo y'omubiri.

question: Omwegye omukozi ondiijo owa sayansi agambira omwegyesa w'eby'obuhangwa n'obukenkuru (Technology Education) aha bw'okubaasa kukora omurimo ogurikugyenda n'eby'okwegyesa bingi omu bintu byombi ebi. Nayenda kukora aha mutwe gw'enshonga y'omuringo gw'amasannyalaze, yaabaasa abaana kubanza kutebeekanisa etabaaza erikweshereza omu mikono. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kworeka, eki kikuru kukira ebindi kiki aha by'okugarukamu ebi orikugambira omurimo ogurikugyenda n'eby'okwegyesa bingi?
answer_a: Teekatebeza omutebeekanisa ogurikukoresa omuringo gw'okwegyesa ogurikwegamira aha mirimo, ogurikugyenda n'ebirikukurwamu n'obureezi kuruga omu masomo goona agari abiri
answer_b: Kora Webquest ahabuurizi abeeshuri kwega emisingi y'eby'obuhangwa bw'omulembe omu bwiire bukeeke.
answer_c: Shobora omukura oguri omunda omu by'eisomo byombi, reero oronde ebiro by'okwegyesa hamwe okukora aha busharizi obutunganirwe.
answer_d: Tebeekanisa em ক্লাাসি zirikukozesa omutindo ogurikukwatana na ICT kutunga emirimo y'abeeshuri

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'etekinoroji acwire kushwijuma n'abegyi be vidiyo y'ebyahandiikirwe erikwetwa 'Ekiteefu ky'Eitaala y'Omushana', erikukwata aha nshonga y'okucureereza obwomeezi bw'ekintu. Ni enyegyesa ki egi egi erikubaasa kwongyerwa omurundi ogu kurugiirira omu kyakozesibwe kwega?
answer_a: Rondera ebyetengo by'abantu ebirimu eby'okumaraho ebizibu omu kubyoma, okuhindura, nari okureetera oburungi, orikuteekateeka aha muhendo gwabyo ogurikubaasika.
answer_b: Shwijuma omuhanda ogurikukiraho okuhandiika enyihura empya z'omuteekano zigumira abantu n'ensi, orikureeba ebiragiro, eby'obushubuzi, eby'obutonde bw'ensi, n'eby'embeera z'abantu.
answer_c: Shobora omuringo n'entebeekanisa y'okumaraho ebyetengo by'okukora, okuhindura, nari okwongyera omubuzima bw'ebintu nari ebintu ebitwetoroire, kurabira omu bikoreso bya ICT
answer_d: Shwijuma ebiteekateeko by'okumaraho ebirikugyenderera kukendeeza ebizibu ebirikuruga omu kukoresa amaani n'obuganga.

question: Okurikira aha mbeera egi: Omwegyesa areeta ebyahandiikwa ebi aha banyeshuri be ab’omwaka gw’okubanza omu mashomero ga sekenda: Ekizibu kimwe ekikuru ekya Omuryango gw’Obumwe bw’Oburaya (European Union) n’okuba ngu ebifo byagwo ebirongoosa amafuta byakadiiwe kandi tibirikukwata aha mitiima nk’ebifo by’omulembe omusya ebiri kukora omuri Asia na Middle East. Ebi byombi byongyeire munonga omu bwingi bw’ebicurizo by’amafuta ebirikwenda omu katale k’ensi yoona, kandi kampani z’Oburaya nizisanga kiri kigumire kwemerera nazo. Aha mbeera ezi, nikyongyerwaho ngu amateeka agumire ag’eby’obutonde bw’omuryango gw’Obumwe bw’Oburaya nigateera ebizibu ebifo ebirongoosa amafuta omu kitundu eki... ekintu eki kirikwoleka amateeka agumire munonga ag’eby’obutonde agariho omuri Spain, ekyareeteire okugara ekifo ekirongoosa amafuta ekya Cepsa omuri Tenerife emyaka eshatu ehwaire. Cepsa neegira ngu amateeka g’omuryango gw’Obumwe bw’Oburaya nigareetera buri kadomola ly’amafuta erirongoosibwe omu bifo byabo bibiri ebiri kukora omuri Spain kugira omutaano gw’omutaano gw’edoola nka ibiri, eki barikutwara nk’omugugu mugumire kwemerera, haine okuhurira ngu nibateerwa abarikurwanirira eby’obutonde, abarikubashinja ngu tibarikugondera emitindo y’eby’obutonde. (Obuhaizi: Econoticias, Energías Renovables www.chiledesar rollosustentable.cl) Kurugiirira aha buhaizi obu, kibu ki eki omwegyesa araabe asaasiize kureetera abanyeshuri be kuteekateeka aha bizibu n’omutaano gwabyo eby’obuhangwa?
answer_a: Niki eki eky'obushomesa eky'amaani ekirikubaasa kuruga omu kulemesa okukuzibwa kw'obuhanga bw'omutaano aha mutendera gw'amakampani g'amafuta g'ebitare kuruga omu itaka omu mwanya gw'okukora sente omu mukago gwa Buraya?
answer_b: Ni nshonga ki ezirikukurira omugasho n’obushoboorozi bw’amarefineri omu Asiya na Middle East?
answer_c: Ebiragiro by'Omukago gwa Yuropo birikugurwa kugira ngu birekyere aha bireetera okukura kw'amakampuni g'amafuta?
answer_d: Ni mukago ki ogu twarikushanga hagati y'embeera erikushoboororwa omu mutwe gw'ebyahandiiko n'embeera y'eby'amakuru omu ihanga ryaitu?

question: Ni enki aha mirimo egi orikukirayo kwenda kukoresa, kuhandiira abaana abeeshuli kuteekateeka omu muringo ogutari gumwe kandi ogurikwegaana?
answer_a: Eizooba ry'omu nsi yo: Omuhanda ogurikuruga omu kyaro kyaanyu okugyenda omu tauni nigwo gwononekire munonga. Eki nikireetera abantu kukora obwire buraingwa omuhanda, emotoka nyingi nizishwekyera, kandi abantu abamwe nibagira obutiinisa bw'okugwa omu kabenje. Ni nshonga ki ezi orikubaasa kuteekateeka okukora kugira ngu orungyiisye omuhanda ogu?
answer_b: Ha i bintu ebirikukoresibwa obutoosha, oteekateeke ebiteekateeko by'oku bikoresa omu muringo ogutari ogwo ogubimanyirweho.
answer_c: Shaba omukoro gw'okunoonyereza omukura gw'omukutu aha miringo erikushaanisa ey'okukora ekintu ky'eteknologiya.
answer_d: Yoreka vidiyo erikukwata aha Kyekiro ky'Obuhangwa n'obwomeezi (Industrial Revolution) orikuhandiike lipoota ehikire aha muringo tekinologia yaahindwiremu abantu.

question: Omutwe gw'abanyeshuri nigugambira omugurusi waabo w'Eby'obuhangwa n'Eshami (Technology Education) ngu nibenda kwega eby'okukora programu za kompyuta, baitu nibagamba ngu tibarikumanya oku barikutandika ahabw'okuba nibakiteekateeka nk'ekintu kigumire munonga. Ni nshonga ki y'obwegyesa ei omwegyesa orikumanya akakozesa okuhiga abanyeshuri n'okuboroberereza kwega ebyo?
answer_a: Yoreka abeeshuri omu mikutu y'ebyahandiikirwe by'emirongoano ebi barikumanya kandi bakakoresa omu magara gaabo ga buri izooba
answer_b: Yoreka abeeshuri omu ndimi z'ekikoompyuta ezibamanyirwe, nk'eza Java, C++, nari PHP
answer_c: Yoreka abegyeshuri eby'okureeberaho by'ebikoreso ebirikukoresibwa okuhwera abegyeshuri kwetegyereza omulingo data erikukoresebwa omu murongo oguhikire
answer_d: Yoreka abeeshuri aha bintu by'omusingye ebikoresebwa omu kubanza okukora programu, nk'omuringo gw'okukuratanisa ebintu (algorithms), ogurikukoresebwa omu mbeera z'obwomeezi bwa burijo

question: Teekateekateeka embeera egi: Omu Tekinologia y'Eby'oburezi, abeeshuri nibakora n'omuringo gw'okukora purojekiti kwetebeekanisa “Eitabaaza erirugire”, eririkugurirwa abantu boona, ahu buri kikundi kirikubaasa kwetebeekanisa akashanda kushoboorora ebintu ebi baahangire n'ebi baakozire, byoona omu mutindo gw'okukura kw'obuhangwa. Omuringo gw'okukora gwashuuruurwa kuraba omu kureeba n'okuheereza lipooti ibiri ezahandiikwa. Omwegyesa naahangaanisa okushuuruura okwa purojekiti y'aha muheru, ekitebeekanisiibwe bwabaire eitabaaza n'ebishanda bya buri kikundi bimaze kwetebeekanisiibwa. Niki ekirikukiraho kukwata aha muringo gw'okushuuruura purojekiti y'aha muheru, twarikuteekateeka obutonde bw'okwega oburikukwatanisa ekikumiro eki?
answer_a: Ekizame ekihandiikirwe eky'ebibuuzo ebirikugururwa ebirikushwijuma okwetegyereza enshonga y'okukura kw'eby'omugasho okurambire omu mirimo y'emitwe etari emwe omu purojekiti egi
answer_b: Ripooti eyaakamalirizo ehandiikwa ekibiina, erimu ebikwaatirwe kuruga omu biteera byoona ebyakozirwe omu purojekiti
answer_c: Rubriki erikukora nk'omucwe gw'okushwijuma ebipimo by'omurimo gwa buri kikundi aha mwanya gw'okugurira n'okutunda, ekugambirwa omwegyesa n'abegyeswa beene.
answer_d: Omuko gw'omuntu omwe-omwe ogurikugambira ahari buri omwegi oku yaahuriire omu murimo gw'ekikundi ogwakozirwe omu mushomo.

question: Teekateeka aha mbeera egi: Omwegyesa aine kukora omwanya gw’aha mukura gw’okubuganira hamwe n’abegyi be kandi yaabaasa kuta omukura ebintu byona ebi arikwenda, nibamanyira ebintu ebi barikwetaga kukora omurimo gw’omuklassi n’ebikorwa; ahu barikubaasa kuteekamu ebintu by’amahanga nk’ebiriho nk’evidiyo, amajwi, ebishushani, nari ebindi. Ni kikurizo ki aha bikoreso by’omutwe gw’ekyoma eki omwegyesa ashemereire kukoresa ahabw’ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Emigani
answer_b: Eicu
answer_c: Flickr
answer_d: MySpace

question: Omwegyesi omukuru owa tekinikali aine kwetegyereza omulingo abegi be bakozeseze obwengye bwabo omu kukora omulimo ogukuru ogw’omugasho aha muheru gw’ekicweka. Okukora omulimo ogu nikikwata ha bintu bingi n’ebihikaanwa ebi aine kwetegyereza. Omu bintu ebi ebiri hansi, ekikuru ki ekirikukirayo oburungi omu kwetegyereza omulingo abegi bakozeseze obwengye bwabo?
answer_a: Rubriiki
answer_b: Ebirikwate kw'okukora ebintu
answer_c: Omugisha gw'okushomesa
answer_d: Ekitabo ky'ebihurikizi ebirikworeka obuhame

question: Omuhanda gw'okwegyesa ogurikukuratirwa omu by'omwegaano by'emikono, ni gurahe aha miringo erikukoresibwa ogurikukwasa abegi kwega ebintu ebirikukorwa butoosha?
answer_a: Okugamba omu bantu nibakora nk'abantu abandi
answer_b: Orurembo rw'okutaayaayira
answer_c: Eky'okureeberaho ekirikwebemberwa
answer_d: Okukora ebizibu

question: Abeshomesha ab'omu mwaka ogw'omunaana, bwamara kwega aha bikorwa bya softiweeya y'okubumbaho appu, bakacwamu kubumba ezaabo bwabo ez'okukoresa omu masimu, okubafaho kurungisa emirimo yaabo n'ebikorwa by'obwegyesa. Birikutaatiirwa ki bishemereire kubaho omu kucweera orubungo aha muringo gw'omutaano ogu?
answer_a: Okukora ebishushani n'okukuumira obutonde bw'ensi
answer_b: Okwerinda abakoresa na eby'obusingye bw'obutonde
answer_c: Okutebeekanisa n'omugasho gwakyo omu itungo ry'eshomero
answer_d: Omugasho n'obukuru bwabyo omu itungo ry'eshomero

question: Nibarikukuratira ebyetengo by’obuteezi bwabo, abeeshumi abari omu mwaka ogwomunaana baazombire entebe z’ekishaaniro ky’abaana abato omu ishomero. Kurikira embeera erikugambwaho, birikuba bita ebi omwegyesa ashemereire kurora arikushwijuma ekyombeko ekyakozirwe abeeshumi, kurikira abarikukikoresa?
answer_a: N'okukoresa ebintu ebirikugura sente nkeyo nari ebintu ebyakozirweho obundi, n'ekyo kikyendeza aha sente ezirikwetengwa.
answer_b: Okukoresa ebintu ebirikubaasa kugarurwa omubusingye nari ebirihoobya obutonde bw’ensi bwona obu buraabe bucureezi bwaba bamaze kukoresa entebe ezo.
answer_c: Kutorana ebintu ebirikukomera kandi ebirikugumira ebirikwija kureetera obucweka bw'okubaka oburikwija kuha entebe amaani n'obugumiro.
answer_d: Okukoresa ebintu ebirikukwasa omuhanda gw'okubaka ogurikuhikaanisa n'emitwarize y'eishomero

question:
Omu kukora omutindo gw'eby'entegyereza, abeeshure b'eky'omutaano nibeejanga ekishushani ky'emotoka eky'omulingo ogu bashaazire, nibakozesa ebintu n'ebikoresho ebirukukwaata, harimu n'ebimwe eby'okutemesa.
Ekintu ki ekya bw'okubanza omwegyesa ashemereire kugambira abeeshure kubaasa kukozesa ebikoresho by'okutemesa omu mulingo ogutali gw'akabi?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa omunshozi okukora omulimo gw'okucwa.
answer_b: Rooraho omusito kandi orikukwata ahantu hamwe kurondaaho aharikukwaata.
answer_c: Reeba ngu bikoreso birungi kandi birimu oburembo obuhikire.
answer_d: Hoolaho enshaho y'okucwekyereza esingwiire aha murimo n'ebintu ebi orikukora nabyo

question: Abanyeshuri b'eky'omwaka ogwa 7 niboonyereza aha nshuranura y'ebintu by'eteknologi omu bwire oburahwire. Omu bikoresho ebi, niki omwegyesa araabe ashoobora kuteekateeka kukoresa kushaba okushaka omu muringo murungi ogw'obuteekaniza n'ogwesigwa?
answer_a: Vidiyo ezi omuri Youtube
answer_b: Omurimo gw'eby'eteknologiya ogw'okuhandiika
answer_c: Ebiragiro by'ebya sayansi n'eby'obuhangwa bw'omuntu
answer_d: Magaziini z'ekikugu n'etekonologiya ezirikukurira omukura gw'omunyeto

question: Abeshomesa b'ekibiina kya munaana baine kukora okunoonyereza okurikukwata aha byafaayo by'enyimba, n'ekigyendererwa ky'okukora omurimo ogwo omu bwangu omu muringo ogw'ekikugu. Ahabw'ekyo, bashaba obuhwezi kuruga omu musomesa w'eby'obuhangwa n'entunguka. Ni bintu ki eby'obuhangwa n'entunguka ebi omusomesa araabe ashohoire nk'ebirikukwata aha kuhindura amakuru g'okunoonyereza?
answer_a: Canva
answer_b: Instagram
answer_c: WordPress
answer_d: Google Chrome

question: Abeshomesa bashemereire kuragirira bata abegi b'omu mwaka gwa munaana kuboneza amakuru ageesigwa omu kwetegyereza ebyetaago ebiriyo omu izooba lyabo, nukwo bashobore kwikiriza eby'okukora?
answer_a: Mwoleke ngu abaishiki bakozese enkorogi z’amakuru ezishashurwa obwaire obwaire
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri bashobore kushuuruura omuntu ou barikwenda kukoragana nawe, kugira ngo batoremu eby'okugarukamu ebirungi.
answer_c: Mugambe abeeshuri bakunganye ebikumirizi ebirikukwasana, nibakoresa ebintu ebirikwohereza n'ebitarikwohereza kwemeza amakuru agu barikutoora.
answer_d: Gambira abaana abegyesibwa ngu bashemereire kwebembera okuhika aha muntu ou baraakorerere nabo, ahabw'okuba niyo nshonga y'okutunga amakuru ageesigwa.

question: Abeshuri abamwe bakazoora oburemeezi bw’okwongyera amaizi omu bitoogo by’ekishomero kyabo. N’ahabw’ekyo, bakacwamu kuta omuringo musya gw’okuhuumuza amaizi ogurikukoresa obutanda omu bitoogo ebi. Twihireho okufaho eby’obutonde, ni nshonga ki omwegyesa ashemereire kuteekateekaaho kubaasa kushwijuma omuringo ogu bakozeseize?
answer_a: Enshuranisho omu miringo y'okukoresa amaizi bwaba tumaze kutunga enkoreso y'okuhuumuza emiti n'ebimera orukumbuuta aha mizizi yabyo
answer_b: Obwingi bw'oburasani oburikubaasa kubiikwa n'enkora y'okuhuumuza emizi.
answer_c: Okushwijuma kw'abantu omukitongole aha nkora y'okuhuumuza emiti n'amaizi omu butooro omu kubahaana kwagyo omu kureeberera ebirime by'omubisi.
answer_d: Okukoresa ebikozirwe omu bintu ebibora (emiyoboro, empombo, enyegyerero, n'ebindi) omu kutebeekanisa enkoresa y'omuringo gw'okuhuumurira ogw'okutonyeza

question: Bwanyima y’okushwijuma engyenderwaho ezirikukiraho, María na Francisca bacwireho kukora ebintu by’okuteramu ebishushani omu kicweka kyabo. Kuti obwo bukoreso bukwate n’obuhangwa bw’omu kicweka kyabo, baine kuteekateeka aha miringo y’omubiri egurikukiraho. Ni isomo ki erikubaasa kwegaitwa omu purojekiti kandi ahabw’enki?
answer_a: Eby'obutonde, okucwamu aha migisha n'ebibi egi twine omu by'obutonde
answer_b: Eby'obushomesha bw'abantu, okucweekereza omugasho gw'ekigyendererwa omu bantu
answer_c: Eshomo, okushobora ebipimo by'eky'okureeberaho ky'ekishushani ekirikuruganizibwa.
answer_d: Obushoboorozi bw'okureeba, kukora omurimo omu biteekateeko by'ebintu ebirikukorwa omu makuru.

question: Omu omwegyesa w’etekonologia omu burema bw’omunaana, abuuza abegyirwa be kucweekereza aha maani g’ekifo ekicweekereza ebipande bya kaada, endyabyaazi, butto za pulasitika, n’ebikoomi bya tetrapack ekiireeteire omu kitongole ekiri haihi n’eishomero. Okurikukurirana n’embeera erikugambwaho, ni bumwe aha miteekateeko y’okwegyesa eyaabaire eshemereire abegyirwa kwega okucondooza aha maani g’ekifo ekicweekereza?
answer_a: Yoreka abegyesha ebitebyo by’ebintu ebirikureebwa nari ebindi ebirikukoresibwa amaisho n’amatu abegi, nibereka emigisha emibi enshaho egi eretera omu butonde bw’ensi, kandi murugyemu emigisha y’eishomero erikukoramu ebintu ebyashangwa omu kitongore.
answer_b: Hanga ebibuuzo n'okwebuuza okurikukora omu bwangu aha bayeshuri, obikozese aha bantu abarikukuraana, kandi mwena mwegatte mushaange ebintu ebi murikwija kubuuza, kugira ngu mushobore kushobora ebirikurugamu omu kifo ky'okutora eby'okukozesa omurundi gwa kabiri omu itungo.
answer_c: Yombeka ekishushani ekirikworeka abeeshure abarikukurirana hamwe n'okworeka ebirikurugamu omu miringo y'emyanda egi, n'omugasho gw'okugaruramu ebintu by'omutaano ogu omu kubuurira obutonde bw'ensi, n'okurugamu obuhunguzi bw'abantu boona.
answer_d: Noonyereza n'abeshuri ebikoreso bya TIC ebirikukiriza okwebuuza n'abantu abarikwetorora eshuro, kubaasa kukoraana ebi barikuteekateeka aha bukuru bw'okugira esente ya recycling y'amashara nk'aga agabuzire omu maka.

question: Omu mushomo gw'Eby'obuhangwa, abeeshuli bashemereire kutebeekanisa ebirikukora kureetera ebyetengo ebirikushangwa omu bibiina byabo eby'emirimo. Omu mirimo egi erikukurira aha, n'oguhe ogurikukwata aha kutebeekanisa ebirikukora ebibiina by'abeeshuli?
answer_a: Yoreka abeeshuri emiringo y’okuteekateeka ebicweeka, nk’omuti gw’ebizibu, okutwariramu ekizibu omu kikondo ky’omuti, reero oijuzye amatabi n’ebikoola by’omuti n’ebicweeka.
answer_b: Hereza abeshomesa ekyahandiikwa nari ekikwaatwa, ekirikubaasa kuba firimu empi, eya butumwa bw’amazima nari ekyahandiikwa, kubaasa kureetera okuteekateeka aha buzibu n’okworobiya okwetegyereza obuzibu bwenyine.
answer_c: Hereza abeeshuri ebikoreso by'okukunganya ebitebe, nk'ebibuzo, obuhabuzi bw'okubuuza abantu, rundi okwejuza ebirikubahwera kukunganya amakuru aha kizibu n'abarikukikwatwaho
answer_d: Ha abaana eby’okugarukamu aha biteeso eby’omutindo ebyashuuranirweho omu bibinja, orikurora aha bintu nk’obushoorozi n’okuhikaana n’ebyetengo ebyabaire bimanyirwe kare.

question: Ekibi y'abeshomesa abari omu mwaka gwa munaana nibeteekanisa kutebeekanisa omurongo gw'ebiro ogurikworeka oku kamera zikuzire. Batanakora omwolesyo, nibamanya ngu baine kuzooka akakoomi akaraabe nikahiga kamera ezi baraayoreke. Ahabw'okuba tibarikumanya kutebeekanisa ekintu ky'omutaano ogu, nibagarukira omwegyesa w'eby'obuhangwa bw'omuringo (Technology) kubahabura. Aha bikurikurataho, niki ekikora nk'omwegyesa ekiraagyeza abeshomesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shaba eky'okubanza kw'ekikorwa n'okuhereza omurongo gw'ebikoreso n'eby'okukoresa abeeshuri baabo abaraakozese, hamwe n'ebirikurugiirira omu kuhingura ekikorwa ekyo.
answer_b: Gambira abeshomesa kukoresa ebishushani by'ebintu byonka, kandi barembeho omushororongo murungi ogukozese ebintu ebi bamazire kumanyira.
answer_c: Yamba abeshomesa kumanya amaani g'ebintu ebi barikwenda kukoresa, kandi obagambire n'emitindo y'okwerinda omu kukoresa ebikoreso, na munonga ebi birikubaasa kureeta akabi.
answer_d: Kukorana n'abeeshure kukora enteekateeka, orikureeba oku kuraashobora kureebeka n'ebintu ebi baraakunda kworeka, kubaasa kubanza kukora enteekateeka y'okubaka ekikoreso.

question: Omu baine kukora omurimo gw’okushoma nibakoresa ICT, niki ekirikukiraho kukuraho ebiragiro by’okukoresa ebintu ebi by’entaano?
answer_a: Ekibuuzo ekirikukora kurabira omukura y'omukutu gwa internet
answer_b: Ekyariko eky'omukura ogurikwenda omuhandiiko
answer_c: Omwegyeserezo y'okushomera aha intaneeti
answer_d: Okutegyeka omu Prezi

question: Omuhendiki w’omu klasse y’eby’eteknologiya omu shomero erikuru, naagambira ekikundi ky’abanyeshuri kwolesa omushinga gw’okutunguura okukoresa amazzi omu itendekyero, arikugira ekyetengo ngu omucwecuro ogurikwolesibwa gube ogurikukuumira obutonde. Ebirikukurikira aha, n’ebirikugambwa ngu omwegyesa ashemereire kuteekateeka omu rubriki y’okushashuura?
answer_a: Ebirikukora omuhanda murungi, eky'omugasho, hamu n'eby'embeera y'abantu n'obutonde.
answer_b: Emyemerero, obuhangwa n'obwebemberi
answer_c: Eby'obutonde, eby'embeera z'abantu, n'eby'enfuna
answer_d: Eihanga, eby'obutonde bw'ensi, hamu n'amaani

question: Omuhanda gw'okukora omurimo gw'obwebembezi nigutwara omuhanda, ebibiina by'abanyasomero abakuru nibareeta oburemeezi bw'omutindo omwingi ahari omwegyesa wabo orikubabuurira. Kukurikirana n'ekimwe ahari byo, omwegyesa naagira ngu bateekanise ekicweka ky'omugisha kya Gantt. Noora kukuratira okugira eki omwegyesa yaagizire, oburemeezi ki eki eki ekibiina eki kiba kyahikireho?
answer_a: Ebintu ebirikukoresibwa kukuraaza omurimo gwaitu tibirikuhikaana n'ebirikwetengwa ebirimu.
answer_b: Twineitu enshoro nyingi z'ebirikukwata aha Webu kandi titurikubaasa kumanya n'enki ekiraakukwasize omumulimo gwaitu gwona oguturikutunga.
answer_c: Hariho emirimo myingi twine kukora kandi nitutiina kubura omutima, tukamara obwire butari bwingi obu twine kutahikire aha kiragiro
answer_d: Ekizibu eki twazwire kirimu engyenderwaza nyingi ezirikubaasa kukuratirwa, nitweta omugyenderwazo gw'okucwamu orukukirayo kuba oruhikire.

question: Omugyezaho naabuuza abegi b’omwaka ogw’omwenda kukora orutaro orurikukwata aha ku tekinologia y’ekintu eki barikukunda yaahindukire. Omugyezaho naabaasa kuteenda ki aha begi nk’enshuro z’amashomo ezirikukwata aha bushishozi bwabo?
answer_a: Ebyahandiikirwe ebyacwekyerwe, okukira munonga ebitabo n'ebinyamakuru ebirikwata aha kintu ekyorondirwe
answer_b: Ebyahandiikwa ebirimu amahurizo agahwerizeho n'amashya aha kicweka ekyatoranirwe
answer_c: Enshuro z'omukuraato ezirimu ebikwaata butoosha aha bitebeeryo ebi baatooranize
answer_d: Ebyahandiiko by’omu magazini nari ebitabo ebihagaziibwe ebibiina ebirikumanywa kandi ebirikukwata aha kintu eki owaatoonire.

question: Omuhanda gw’okukuratira ogurikwija kwikiriza okushishoza yaaba eby’okworeka nibihikaana n’ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekiragwiirwe nikyo ki? Abegi nibashobora kushoborora omuringo eby’okutangaanisa byahindwiremu abantu n’obutonde bwabo omu bwire obuhingwire, nibagambira aha birungi n’ebibi ebyabireho.
answer_a: Shobora ebyahindwire omu muringo gw'empamba z'abaana omu myaka makumi ana ehingwire
answer_b: Shobora bimwe ebiruga omu kubaho kw'empuuyo ezirikushangwa omu magara g'eka buri izooba
answer_c: Mbwenu engyenderwaho y’okukora dayipa zaahinduka eta kurugiirira aha ku zaakuziremu?
answer_d: Gambira eby’abakozesa abataireho amagezi g’okurwanisa eby’obubi oburikurugamu omu kukoresa empuuyo aha butonde bw’ensi

question: Omu omukuru omu iraasa ry’ahaiguru, omugyezibwa naayoreka ekizibu ky’emyanda erikukira aha ishomero, okugyeragyeranisa n’amashomero agirikushushana. Naayoreka etaabulo erimu obwingi bw’emyanda erikukorwa omu kwezi kumwe, yaagyeragyeranisa n’omuringo gw’emyanda erikukorwa omu mashomero agandi. Omu iraasa, omu bibinja, abeeshuri nibatoora engyenderwaho ezirikubaasa kukoresibwa kurabira omu buheereza. Okurikukwatana n’embeera erikushoboororwa, kiki ekirikworeka ekirikukwasa kwetegyereza okuhandiika engyenderwaho y’obuheereza omu muringo ogurikwera?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebiragiro ebirikukuratirwa omu kusharamu omuringo gw'okuheereza (okubaasa kw'omuringo ogwo, ebiragiro by'obuhangwa, eki abarikwakiikirwa barikwenda, n'ebindi) ahabw'okucwamu omuringo gw'okuheereza.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza obuhangwa bw’omurimo ogwakozirwe n’ebikoreso bya digito ebikozirwe, okurikurugaana n’obwetengo nari oburemeezi ebyaba nibireeberwa.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza ebiragiro by'okumaraho ebyetengo ebirikumanywa nari emigisha erikwetenga okukora obuhereza, kurugiirira aha biragiro ebirateirweho
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ebirungi n'ebibi ebirikubaaho (eby'obutonde, eby'omuntu, nari hamwe) ahabw'obuhereza obwombekirwe.

question: Kandi abanyeshuri abarikwega tekinolojiya omwaka ogwabo ogw'okubanza, basobole kushobora omugisha rundi obwetaago oburikubaasa kukorerwa omurimo, baine kureeba okumara esande nk'emu oku kafeeri y'eishomero erikukora omu bwire bw'okureemura. Twaba niturora ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: 'Kushobora emigisha rundi obwetaago bw'omuntu, ekibiina, rundi ekyanga egi erikwetenga okukora omurimo.' Murimo ki ogw'okucereebeza ogurikwija kureetera kumanya ngu eki kigyendererwa ky'okwega kyahikiirirwe omu mbeera egi erikugambwaho?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibarikworeka ebirikugambwaho ebi barikureeba omu kafeeriya kurabira omu kworeka ebifaananyi byabo omu mashini.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibarikwohereza orutonde lw'oburemeezi oburikushangwa omu mbeera ezirikureebwa omu kafeeriya, nibakoresa puroguraamu y'okwohereza ebintu.
answer_c: Abeshuri nibo bahanga orubazo rwa Prezi aha biteekateeko by'okuheereza ebirikukora aha buzibu oburikurebwa omu kafeeriya, nk'okujanjamana n'obucafu.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibooleka vidiyo erimu ebyo abeeshuli baagizire abeeshuli abandi n'ebiteekateeko byabo aha mbeera ezo babonire omu kafeeriya omu bwire bw'okuliya ekyemisana

question: Omu omukuru omu ishomero ry’ahaagati omu ক্লাসে y’eby’obuhangwa nobwo techonology, ekicweka ky’okubanza kw’entebeekanisa y’emirimo nikikorerwaho. Omwegyesa ashabire ebibiina by’abakozi kukora orutaro orurikworeka okugyenda omu maiso omu kicweka eki ky’emirimo. Kuruga omu muringo gw’omurimo ogu, obukuru bw’okworeka okugyenda omu maiso omu ক্লাসে omu kicweka ky’entebeekanisa niki?
answer_a: Kukora hamwe omu mutindo ogurikworeka obumanzi bw'ekikundi n'okugurukura kwemereza okutunga ebirikukurahura n'endengo kuruga owa omwe omukuru omuri service yaabo
answer_b: Kushwijukya kusesereza omugasho ogu omurimo ogu guretsireho kuhika hati hamwe n'okutebeekanisa enyenzereza ezirikwija kugasira etungo erikuru ery'omushinga.
answer_c: Kuhwereza omu kubaza ebiteekateeko ebirungi okuhakanira aha matungo agakorirwe omu kutuunga emirimo kurugiirira aha bigendererwa by'omurimo.
answer_d: Kugambira abantu aha kuzaana omu kubazaho ebirikukorwa, kwakiira ebi buri kimwe aha bibiina kirikugambaho, n'okukora omuringo gw'okutunga ebiri kukora gye kurugiirira aha kigyendererwa ekya bwambere.

question: Omuhendiisa omu kubumbabumba omurimo, acwireho kworeka abegi okukoresa ecati ya Gantt kuraba omu murimo. Omu mirimo egyi erikukurira, nigiha abegi obwengye bw'ekigendererwa n'omugasho gw'ecati ya Gantt omu mirimo yaabo ey'okuhereza?
answer_a:
Ha abegi abeshomesa obumwe oburikushobora kubahwera kukora enteekateeka n’okukurikiraniza emirimo yabo omu bwiire.

Ekishushani kya Gantt: Ni muringo gw’okushushana enteekateeka y’omurimo ogurikworeka ebiro by’okutandika n’eby’okuhwa by’omurimo, hamwe n’obwiire oburikwetagisa kumumaririza. Nikikuhwera kureeba emirimo egiine kukorwa, obwiire oburikwetagisa, n’oku emirimo erikukwatana.

Eby’okurorraho by’okuzaana ekishushani kya Gantt omu mirimo etari emwe:

1. Okwombeka enju: Noobaasa kukoresa ekishushani kya Gantt kutebeekanisa n’okukurikiraniza emirimo nk’okusiima omunsi, okuta omusingi, okwombeka ebisenge, okuta amataafaari, okushiga rangi, n’ebindi.

2. Okutebeekanisa orugyendo: Noobaasa kukoresa ekishushani kya Gantt kutebeekanisa orugyendo rwaawe, okutandika n’okushaka eby’okurorraho, okucweeka enyonyi, okucweeka eby’okurara, n’okutebeekanisa ebiro by’okugyenda.

3. Okukora omurimo gw’aha ishomero: Noobaasa kukoresa ekishushani kya Gantt kutebeekanisa n’okukurikiraniza omurimo ogwawe gw’aha ishomero, okutandika n’okushoma, okushaka ebirikukwatana n’omurimo, okuhandiika, n’okuhereza omurimo.
answer_b: Hamwe n'abanyeshuri, yolesa omulinganizo gw'emirimo omu kubangira ekintu rundi obuhereza, ebiheebwa omu butali buteekanizibwe, omu cchati ya Gantt
answer_c: Shaba omurimo ogu mureeteire kwombeka, hanyuma mushabe abeeshuri kushaho ebikorwa, obwire bw'okubimariiriza, kandi mubitebeekanise omu kacweka ka Gantt.
answer_d: Yoreka abeshomesa eby'okureeberaho by'okukoresa emiringo etari emwe emwe y'ebicweka bya "Gantt" omu purojekiti ezirikukora ebintu n'obuhereza butari bumwe, nooleka emigasho ya buri kimwe.

question: Omukuru w’eishomero ashomesereize okweyongyera okurikukiraho kw’amaizi agurikukoresibwa kandi yagambira abegyesi b’eishomero ekyo. Omwegyesa w’eby’obuhangwa owa II Medio acwireho kworeka abegi be ekizibu eki, omu muringo gw’ekicweka “Okutunga omugasho kurungi omu bintu ebirikukoresibwa”, ahabw’ekigyendererwa ky’okushaka enshonga z’ekizibu eki. Ni murimo ki aha mirimo egi orikubaasa kureka abegi kuteeraho enshonga z’ekizibu eki ekigambirwe?
answer_a: Shaba eby'okureeberaho eby'okukoresa amaizi omu muringo murungi omu by'obureezi ebindi ebi orikubaasa kutoorana omu ishomero
answer_b:
Ebiragiro ikumi eby'okukora ebirikugyenda nibihwera omu kukendeeza n'okufaho aha mbeera y'amaizi omu ishomero:

1. Koresa amaizi g'omu nkoni omu muringo ogurikwetengyesa.
2. Teeraho amataapu g'amaizi kurugiirira bwaba nigataama.
3. Oyegyese abandi abanyeshuri n'abareebi aha bukuru bw'okukendeeza amaizi.
4. Kora entebeekanisa y'okukwata amaizi g'enkuba n'okugakoresa omu mirimo nk'okuhira ebimera.
5. Koresa amaizi agaire kukoresebwa omu mirimo endiijo nk'okwoza.
6. Tera omukago n'ab'eishomero abandi kukora enteekateeka z'okukendeeza amaizi.
7. Hindura amataapu g'amaizi agataama n'agarikukozesa amaizi gye.
8. Hira ebimera by'omu ishomero omu kasheeshe nari obwire bw'akasheeshe kukendeeza okufuumuka kw'amaizi.
9. Kozesa ebitoogo by'okwoza engaro ebirikukendeeza amaizi.
10. Yegyesa abanyeshuri aha miringo y'okukendeeza amaizi omu maka gaabo.
answer_c: Gamba eky'omugasho gw'okukoresa amaizi omu muringo murungi n'oburemeezi oburikuruga omu kutahurikiza aha bushoborozi obu omu ishomero.
answer_d: Reeba okukoresa amaizi omu bitoogo by'eshomero ebirikushaanisa, kubaasa kushoboorora obutandwa bw'ekizibu.

question: Ni enki aha mirimo egi orikukirayo kubaho murungi kucungura okukura kw'emitwarize omu by'okwerinda n'okwetangira akabi omu muringo gw'okukuriza omu buhereza?
answer_a: Okukora omugani gw'okutooreza omukoro ogurikukorwa.
answer_b: Okutebeekanisa lipooti ehandiikirwe aha mateeka agariho hati
answer_c: Okukoresa ekizibu ky'okuhandiika ekirimu ebibuuzo eby'okukura
answer_d: Kukora ekizame ky'omumwa aha nyegyesa y'omushonga

question: Ekibi y'abakuru b'essomero erikuru ery'ebyemikono, hamwe n'abegyesi, nibakora aha miringo egi: Okucweekamu ebi etengo kuruga omu Mushinga gw'Eshomero. Okucweekamu ebi etengo kuruga omu butungi bw'omunsi omuriikaraho. Okucweekamu embeera y'emirimo n'emitwarize y'abanyeshomero n'abantu b'omu kitongore ky'eby'obwegyesi. Essomero eri riri aha kiicweka ki ky'okukurira endagamuntu y'ebyetengo by'abegyesi?
answer_a: Obukuru bw'ebirikukoresibwa kwesuurira.
answer_b: Okwehurira ebiceera by'omubazi
answer_c: Obwire bw'okubaasa kwetegyereza ebintu ebirikukoresibwa
answer_d: Okutebeekanisibwa kw'enteekaniza

question: Omugyezaho ashemereire kutoorana omuringo gw’okwegyesa okukoresa omuringo murungi, ogurikukwatana n’okukoresa eby’omashanyarazi. Okukira munonga, naija kwenda abegi be kwega kukoresa ebyo bikoreso nibataireho omutima aha mutekano gwabo n’ogw’abandi omu kukora nabyo. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha ezirikukurugaho erikubasisa kwegyesa ekyo kurungi?
answer_a: Eky’okuragirira
answer_b: Eky'okureeberaho
answer_c: Eky'okureeberaho ekirikwebemberwa
answer_d: Okukora ebizibu kuruga omuhanda

question: Ni enki aha ebiteekateeko by'omutaaho ogurikukurira omwegyesa w'ekitaano kumwohereza obuhame bw'omutindo ogurikworeka oku kuteekateeka kw'eby'omutaaho kurikuhikiiriza ebi abantu barikwenda?
answer_a: Okuhangura batri ekora n'ebiramu erikwejumbura obutoosha ahabw'okugyeza, nikikora aha bwetaazyo bw'okukuumira amaani g'omushana.
answer_b: Okukora eky'akaisiija eky'omushana ekirikukwasa kureeta amashanyarazi, nikikora aha bwetaago bw'okuchajiira amasimu.
answer_c: Okuhanga omushini ogurikubaasa kugaruramu empapura z'omu ofiisi ezirikuba zashangwa n'okuzihindura eza toilet, nikikora aha bwetaaro bw'okukoresa obutungi bw'ensi omu muringo murungi
answer_d: Okukura kw'ebimera ebirikubaasa kureeta omushana hatariho okucweera, nibikora aha bwetaazi bw'okujaho oburyo bw'emisana obwa ira n'obundi oburikukora gye.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekibiina kya 7, omu biteekateekwa by'okwegyesa ebirimu ekigyendererwa eki: "Kuteekateeka engyenderwamu z'okukora omuhanda, okuhindura nari okwongyera omutindo", atwara abegyeswa be okutegyereza eduka ly'ebintu ery'eishomero, omuri eterekwa ebikoreso by'eteknologi n'ebitebe ebyalekwa, ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okukora omusomo gw'okukora omuhanda, okuhindura nari okwongyera omutindo gw'ekintu ky'eteknologi. Kurugiirira aha kigyendererwa ky'omwegyesa, niki eki abegyeswa bashemereire kubanza kukora okukora omusomo gwabo gw'okukora omuhanda?
answer_a: Shwijuma kandi ohingure ebintu ebiriyo n'ebirikukoresibwa, reero orondoorore obushoboorozi bw'okubirongoora.
answer_b: Sharamura ebikorwa ebyetaagisa omu kureeba oba okuhindura ebintu n'ebikoreso by'eishomero.
answer_c: Chaguura ebikozesebwa ebiriyo omu ishomero ebi orikubaasa kukoresa kukora ebiri kwangirika omu bintu.
answer_d: Shobora ebiragiro ebi barikukoresa kukora empinduka n'okuhwerekyereza ebintu ebirikubaasa kukoresibwa omurundi ogundi

question:
Omuhwezi w’ekicweka ky’omunaana n’agumya abegi be kukoresa ebintu ebirikushangwa butoosha omu kuzoora ebintu by’obuhanga, arikubagambira ngu nibwo buryo bwokukora omurimo gwabo.
Ni nkahi aha biteekateeko ebi ebirikubaasa kuba nibyihirira omumaiso omu kuteekateeka oku omwegyesa arikusaba abegi be?
answer_a: Emyemeru
answer_b: Eby'obuhanga
answer_c: Obwengye
answer_d: Omuko gw'okukora

question: Ekibi y'abeshuri nibeeteeraho ekirikugambira omuntu ekintu eki ekibiina kyakozire kirikukora nk'oku kirikwetengwa kukora. Aha birikukurataho, ekirikugambira omuntu ki eki abeshuri baakozire ekirikushobora kucwa orubanza aha kintu eki?
answer_a: Ebikoresho ebyatoorainwe okucwa n'okwegata ebice by'ekintu nibihikaire aha miringo y'ebikozesebwa.
answer_b: Ebiragiro ebirakozesibwe nibihikiire aha bitebeekaniso by'ekintu ekyakozirwe, nk'amaani, obugumu, n'obugumisirizo.
answer_c: Omuringo n'omuguzi gw'ebikozesebwa ebyakozesibwe omu kuzoora ekintu nibihikaana n'emitwarize n'embeera eky'ekikozesebwa kirikukozesebwamu.
answer_d: Emitwarize erikukoresibwa zigwirire omu miringo y'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu kuzoora ekintu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa omwaka ogwa mushanju ari kukora aha kiragiro eki: "Kutebeekanisa ebicweka nari ebipimo by'okukora omutaano orikurora aha mutekano." Ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri kyakozire omuteekateeki gw'okuhanga obutebe bw'amabaaho bw'amabaare bw'okuteraho obuhabuzi bw'emirimo aha muheru gw'ekicweka n'okutaanura ezo ezashomwa kuruga omu ezo ezitarashomwa. Omu bwire bw'ekicweka, omwegyesa naamanya ngu abanyeshuri nibakikiriza ngu tikirikwetagisa kuteera amateeka g'omutekano gona g'okukora omutaano ogu. Omu miringo egi erikukurataho, niki ekikorwa ky'omwegyesa ekiraakikiriza kugarura omutaano ogu abanyeshuri?
answer_a: Yoreka abeshomesha oburyo oburikwija kubaho obw’akabi bw’okukoresa ebintu ebi omuhanda ogutari murungi n’omuringo eki kirikubaasa kureetera omurimo kutahikiiriza ebiragiro by’omuringo ogurikugwenda kukora nari kutagira oburaingwa bw’obwomeezi oburikukikwaata.
answer_b: Buzibuuze abeeshuri ebikoresho ebi barikukoresa kukora omugisha gwabo kandi obashoboorore obukuru bw'okumanya emiringo y'okukora nabyo omu muringo ogurikwenda kwetantara akabi omu bwiire bw'okugukora.
answer_c: Yoreka abeshomesa vidiyo erikworeka oburemeezi oburikubaasa kubaho twaba tutarikukuratira amateeka g'obuteeka, orikutsindikaana ngu eki nikibaasa kutaataaganya ebikwatiraine n'omulingo ogw'omushinga ogukozirwe.
answer_d: Ha abeshomesa abeeshuri orutondeeka rw'emiringo mikuru ey'okukoresa ebikozesebwa (okushara, okukoomba, okwegataana ebice, n'ebindi) kandi obabuuze okuhuriirana egi n'obucureezi oburikwetagisa kukora buri gumwe.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa omwaka ogwa 7 nagamba aha bigyendererwa ebi: "Shoboorora emigarukiro y'eby'obutonde egiirikuruga omu kuteekateeka eby'obuhangwa." Aha kutandika kw'eklassi, nashoboorora omukago oguri hagati y'emigarukiro y'eby'obutonde n'ebirikuteekateekwa omu by'obuhangwa ebi ebiirikubireeta, kwonka akareeba ngu abeeshuri tibarikwetegyereza gye omukago ogu, yaacwamu kuteekamu eky'okureeberaho.
Ni enki aha biteekateeko ebi ekirikushobora kuba eky'okureeberaho kirungi abeeshuri kwetegyereza omukago ogu?
answer_a: Gamba ebizibu ebireetwa obuceere bwa pulasitika omu nyanja nk'ebizinga by'ebisasiro, okutwara eby'obuzarizi bw'ebinyanya omu mazi, n'ebindi.
answer_b: Yoreka ebigarama ebirikworeka omuhendo gwa CO2 ogurikurekurwa omu mwanya omu byombeko ebirikukora ebintu ebitari bimwe na bimwe ebyashangwa omu ihanga ryona
answer_c: Yoreka eby’amakuru aha bikorwa by’amakaratasi n’obuhame oburikukwata aha kutema eibanga, okucwekyereza ebitaturo by’ebiramu, n’empiinduka ezirikukwatana n’omuzunguruko gw’amaizi.
answer_d: Ebiragiro by'okutwara n'eby'amakolero byayambukize bite omubisi gw'ensi yoona ahabw'okugwiira kw'emyeziro y'omuka ogurikwata obushuuru?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eby'eteknologi omuhanda gw'okuhangaho ebintu bisya aha baineishomero be ab'omwaka ogwa 7, ngu bashobore kugukoresa omu mirimo ei barikukora n'okushwijuma yaaba nibaija kugukoresa. Omu bintu ebi ebiri ahansi, eki ki ekirikubaasa kukoresibwa nk'eky'okureeberaho ekirikworeka omuhanda gw'okuhangaho ebintu bisya ogurikukoresebwa omu kucura omushonga omu by'eteknologi?
answer_a: Okuhanga ChatBot roboti, erikugamiirwa aha bwengye bw’omuntu okugambirana n’abantu n’okumaraho okubanganisa kwona okurikukwata aha kutaana eby’entaana. Eribasa kumanya omugyegyere gwona oguraashe omucaafu kurabira omu kubuuza n’eiraka nari ekishushani.
answer_b: Okuhindura kompyuta emebeeyi kukoresebwa nk'obutooni obwangu, ekikoresebwa munonga kureetera abaana abaine oburemeezi bw'omutwe kumanya enshonga n'ebirikukurataho
answer_c: Okukora kurungi omu muringo ogurikukorwamu ebintu ebyakozirweho obuto omu mahanga agateerereize omu mitendera yaabyo yoona, nk'okukora ebintu omu muringo ogurikukuumira eby'obutonde (eco-design), ngu ebikozesebwa byabyo bikorweho obuto omu muringo murungi, kurabira omu kukoraana enkuumi n'entebeekanisa z'amashaza, kuhika aha kukozesa ebintu ebyo obuto.
answer_d: Okukura kw'eteknology ya nano, erikugira obushoboorozi bw'okuhanga n'okubumba ebintu kuruga omu bunini bw'akamu, n'ebirikukoresibwa bingi, nk'omu makuru g'eby'obusa, nibukubaasa kuhikiiriza obuhangwa obukuru omu kwakiza kansa

question:
Abegyesereza b'eby'emiramu n'abegyesi b'enshaho omu mwaka gwa 5 bakiriziize kukora hamwe aha mutwe gw'enshaho ogurikukwata aha: okukura kw'ekiti. Ahar'ekyo, omwegyesa w'eby'emiramu ashabire abegi be kukora orutaro orurikushoboorora engyenda egi, ahabw'okugumya obwomeezi obwatoonirwe omu nshaho kandi, n'okukora ebikoreso by'okwegyesa abegi b'omu mwaka gwa 3, abarikwetenga nabo kwega engyenda egi.
Omu bikoreso by'eby'emiramu ebiri aha hansi, nikyo kirungi kukoresa kukora orutaro, twaba nitutwara omu maisho ekigyendererwa n'omutindo gw'abegi?
answer_a: PowerPoint, okukoresa ebyahandiikwa n'ebishushani
answer_b: Omukozi orikukora vidiyo, okureeta hamwe n'okuhindura vidiyo
answer_c: AnimatorDV, kukora ekishushani ky'okuhindura ebintu
answer_d: Padlet, okuhandiika ebintu by’omugasho kwetegyereza omulingo ogu kikolebwamu

question: Abanyeshuri omuri kiraasi ey'omukaaga bakozeseze omutwe ogurikugamba aha Kigendererwa ky'Okwega "Kutebeekanisa ebintu by'obuhangwa bwa tekinolojiya kucumura ebizibu, kuronda n'okuhindura ebintu." Bakehire kworeka ebizibu ebitacumurirwe omu maka gaabo n'okutorana ekintu eki, hamwe n'okukihindura, kirikubaasa kubacumurira. Baine kworeka ebirugiremu by'omurimo gwabo omu kiraasi kubaasa kuheebwa ebihendo kuruga aha banywani baabo. Ni ndyoha aha ndyazo zombi ezirikubaasa kwongyerwa omu murongo gw'okushoboora ogurikukoresibwa abanyeshuri kuheereza abanywani baabo ebihendo omu kutuura ekigendererwa?
answer_a: Nibatorura ekintu ekirikubaasa kugarukamu obukure bwabaire nibamanyisa omu ka. Nibateekateeka empinduka aha kintu kuraba omu bishushani nari edaragiramu.
answer_b: Nibamushobora kushanga omuringo gw’okumaraho ekyetengo ekirohoire omu ka. Nibarikwatura amaziina n’okushoboorora ebikorwa ebyetengwa omu kwongyera omutindo gw’ekikoreso ky’obuhanga.
answer_c: Nibarikira amaziina kandi bagamba ebintu ebirikukorwa okwongyera omubazi gw'eby'obuhangwa. Nibatoorana kandi bagamba oburyo oburikukoresibwa okwongyera omubazi gw'ekintu.
answer_d: Nibarikira ebirikukurira omu butonde bw’ensi n’ebirikukwata aha bantu ebi ebikoreso ebi bakozesa bireeta. Nibatoorana ebintu n’ebikoreso ebyetaagisa omuri buri kicweka ky’ekintu eki kigyenda kuhindurwa.

question: Omuhanda gw’okukora ebintu ebirungi omu “Kuhanga ebintu ebisya eby’ebintu rundi enkora z’omutegyeki”, ekibiina ky’abanyeshuri ab’omukaaga kyakozire orupapura rw’enteekateeka y’omushomo omubo barikukoresa buttoori z’omuringa ezirimu omwenda kugira ngu bazimbe entebe omu rurembo rw’ishomero ryabo. Okwetwaza oku barikugamba ngu nikyo kirugiremu nikyo ngu nikiba nikintu ekisya ahabw’okuba nikiba nikikozirwe omu bintu ebitarikumanywa ebirikubaasa kwemera nkuba n’eisheesha. Ni ki aha bigambo ebi ekyarikubaasa kwiha omwegyesa eby’okugarukamu aha banyeshuri kuruga aha muhanda gw’omugasho?
answer_a: "Okozire gye murungi munonga. Okozire omu murimo ogurikukwata aha kizibu ekirikukwata aha mbeera yaawe kandi ekimanyirwe. Kwonka, nobukiraaba otyo, oshemereire kushoboorora emitwarize y’ebintu ebi orikwija kukoresa, nk’obukaka n’obugumu."
answer_b: "Ni orungi. Okozire kushobora kutebeekanisa ekintu ekiihuriireho kuraba omu bintu ebirikukoresibwa obundi, kwonka oshemereire kuteekateeka oku orikwija kuteera n'okugyatanisa butto nk'oku kirikubaasa kuhiga oburemezi bw'abantu abarikukikoresa."
answer_c: "Ninkusiima. Omugasho gwaawe niguhikire kandi nigukora, ahabw'okuba niguteekateeka omuringo oguraahwereza obutonde bw'ensi kurabira omu kucweeka obucafu, kwonka ninkuhanuura kureeba obwangye bw'aha mwanya oguraakoresa."
answer_d: “Omurimo murungi gw’ekikundi. Nimbashaba mugyeragyeranise omurimo gwanyu n’emirimo endiijo erikushushana nagwo, nk’entebe z’omu parki n’omu maduuka, murikureeba ebintu ebirikuzigira kwikiriza abantu.”

question: Omu itsya omuri kiraasi eya mushanju, ekikundi ky'abanyeshuri nibateekaniza kukora entebe eyabo, nk'obwire bw'okutuura hamwe abantu barikugamba. Kurugiirira aha buteekanizi bwabo, baine kutaaho entebe egi, bwanyima bakateekateeka omuhendo gw'ebintu ebi baraakoresa n'omuringo gw'okugikora. Bintu ki abanyeshuri abarikwihiirira kuba nibamanyire kubaasa kutaaho entebe egi?
answer_a: Emisingye mikuru y'eby'obuhangwa bw'omubiri (ergonomics)
answer_b: Emisingye mikuru y'okushushana ebintu oyorobanisa (drawing to scale)
answer_c: Emitwarize y'okukoresa ebikoreso by'okushushana eby'obuhanga
answer_d: Engyesereza z'okukwata omu migaano n'okukoresa ebikoreso

question: Omuhwezi omu bitebe by'omumwanya gw'eky'okumwenda (8), nayeteekaniza isomo rye, arikurugiirira aha mutwe "Okushwijuma n'okukora kw'omutaano", aine ekigyendererwa ky'okuhindura ekikorwa ky'eteknologiya ekyatooranirwe, arikurugiira aha makuru agakuraine omu kugezesa abakoresa. Obureezi obu omuhwezi ashemereire kugumya obwangu okukora ekigyendererwa ekyagambirwe ni buriha?
answer_a: Koresa omuringo gw'okugambira n'okushushana ebintu omu bishushani.
answer_b: Shuuruura ebintu by'omusingye n'ebyombeko by'okubaza ebishushani
answer_c: Manyi amanye obuhangwa bw'okushwijuma data n'okucwamu ebirikukurataho
answer_d: Manyakizo g'ebikoresho by'okukusanya amakuru n'emitwarize yaabyo

question: Omwegyesereza kandi oyetegyereze obusinge n'omugasho, n'oburemeezi bw'omugasho, n'eby'obutonde bw'ensi ebi orikukora. Omu ishomero, omugurusi nashoborra abegi omugasho gw'eby'omugasho by'omutindo, baitu abegi bamwe tibarikwetegyereza omukago oguri hagati y'eby'omugasho n'obusinge. Omugurusi acwireho kukoresa eky'okureeberaho. Ni eki ky'okureeberaho ki eki kirikubaasa kukoresebwa omugurusi kushoborra?
answer_a: Okuhangura esimu, ekahereza omuringo mushya ogw'okuhurirana hamwe n'okushoborora okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa obuhyahya omu by'okuhurirana.
answer_b: Okutonda omukura ogwa Intaneeti, ogwataireho omuhendo gw'enzira mpya z'eby'obushubuzi ezirikushoborora emiringo etari emwe ey'okwebembera eby'emishahara n'eby'obushubuzi
answer_c: Okuhangahanga kw'ebyuma n'enjini z'omukka, ebyareetera okweyongera kw'omulingo gw'ebintu omu bwire bukye, nikireetera okubaasika kuhika aha katale kanini.
answer_d: Okuhangura emicwe y’obucucu, ekagumisiriza okucungura endwara ezirikwata abantu omu bwingi, neyongyera aha muure gw’amagara g’abantu, n’okutaho amateeka ga gavumenti omu kicweka eki.

question: Omuhendo gw'emirimo ogurikukurirana gye n'enteekateeka y'eby'okwegyesa erikwata aha kuteekateeka omu bintu bya Tekinologia?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibashaka obuhame omu nshuro ezitari zimwe na network z'omukago aha bigambo by'obushuhe, kandi bagyeranishe okubatanganirwa oku birikureeta n'amashomo g'abahanga agariho.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibakora orutonde rw'enshonga ezirikubaasa kuba zikakuratiireho obushobezi bw'okubeshya kandi bakashwijuma kuruga omu butungi bw'abantu, eby'obushubuzi, n'eby'obuhanga.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibahimba ebibuuzo by'okubuuza omuntu owagyenda aha kwezi, n'ebibuuzo ebigyendereire kushuuruura amazima g'ebishuba ebirikugambwa. Bwanyima, niboonyereza aha buhame bw'abantu abagyenda aha kwezi omu bitabo ebirikushoborora.
answer_d: Abeshuri nibareeba filimu erikwetwa “Baitu Omuntu Buzima Akataaya Omwezi?”, erikwoleka obuhame oburikukwata aha kuhatira omwezi okwa 1969. Enyima y’ekyo, nibahandiika omwandiko ogurikworeka ekyetengo kyabo aha nshonga egi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu omurasi gwa P6 agyenda kwegyesa abegi be ebitekerezo by'ahaiguru, empimo, n'enteekateeka, nukwo bashobore kwolekya ebintu ebi barikutebeekanisa omu bwijwire. Ni kikii aha bikorwa by'omwegyesa ekyahwere abegi kwetegyereza omulingo gw'okukora ebitekerezo ebi?
answer_a: Higa abeshomesa bateekateeke ekitebe "kiri kutaangira" omu mpimbi y'ekicweka kandi okimurikiize omu muringo oguhikire aha bisika by'ekicweka n'aha butaka. Yoreka ngu ebisiisi ebirikureebwa nibihikaana n'okureeba okurikwenda. Bwanyima, obabuuze ebibuuzo ebi: okureeba nikwingana ki? Omukago guri guta hagati yaabyo?
answer_b: Gambira abeshomesa kuteekateeka ekishushani ekikuru ky'ekintu rundi ekicweka, nukwo bamanye eby'okurora eby'omugando (orthogonal projection) ahari buli ndege, nk'ezi ezirikushangwa omu klasirumu. Hanyuma, gambira ngu endege ezi nituzeta endege y'ahaiguru (elevation plane), endege y'ahaiguru (plan plane), hamu n'endege y'omutwaro (profile plane), n'ebishushani ebirikurorwa ahari buli emwe nibyo turikweta okuroora kw'ahaiguru (elevation view).
answer_c: Shoborora abegi abeshomesa ngu ebishushani ebiragwire by'ekintu nibyetwa emiringo, ahabw'okuba buri kishushani ekiragwire nikihika haihi n'omuringo twaba twine gw'ekintu twaba tukireebire omuhanda hare munonga, n'endimi erengyereza, omu bwangu bw'emisiri eragira.
answer_d: Buzibye abeeshuri: ekintu kigira emiringo mingaha ey'okukireeberamu? mingaha ahari egyo ei turikwetenga kworeka ekintu? Reero mushobororee ngu byona bishingire aha mwanya ekintu kirimu nikikwatagana n'ebibaho ebirikwoleka, kandi omu kukora ekintu kishemereire obutoosha kuteebwa omu mwanya ogurikworeka obwingi bw'enyindo zaakyo ziri oruganda nari zigyendereire aha bibaho ebyo.

question: Omuhwezi naayegyesa abegi b'omu kiraasi eya munaana, arikukwata aha maani g'ebirikukorwa n'eby'obuhangwa bw'omuringo ogundi, omwegyesa naayanjura omugyenzo gw'okukora ebintu ebirikuhwaho (planned obsolescence - PO), naagamba aha migisha gu guine aha kwongyera amataka g'eby'obuhangwa bw'omuringo ogundi. Obu barikugamba oku turikubaasa kucungura ekyo kintu, abegi niboreka okutahurira kandi nibagamba ebiteekateeko byabo aha oku kirikugumira kugarura engyenderwaho y'akatale y'okukora n'okutunda bingi. Aha bw'enjuro ezirikukurataho, n'enjuro ki ey'omwegyesa eyarukukwata aha bwoba bw'abegi kandi eyarukuhiga obureezi oburikwetengwa kukura omu isomo eryo?
answer_a: "Buzima, ekintu ky'okukoresa obuhangwa bw'omuntu kikutworeka ngu okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa obw'omuntu kurimu obubi aha mitendera etari emwe kandi tikurikubaasa kusiimwa butoosha hatariho kubuuza, nari nitwija kuba nitureeta obwonooni bw'obutonde obutari bw'okukoraana."
answer_b: "Obwo buzibu obu nibukwata ensi yoona, nikiragarra haihi ngu amahanga goona gategerezebwa okugumira hamwe okubucwamu; n'ekyo ahabwenki tushemereire kuba nitutaho omutima aha nteerane n'encongereza eziraatuhwere okukora endagaano aha mutindo gw'ensi yoona."
answer_c: "Eiz'eikaali terikora erikora yenyine, erikukiriza ebi abaguzi barikwenda, kandi ekizibu eki nikitureetera kucweekereza n'okushwijuma emicwe yaitu y'okugura ebintu kureeba oku turikwetaba omu muringo ogu ogw'omutaano n'oku turikubaasa kuguhingura."
answer_d: "Niyo ahabw'ekyo kikuru abantu omu bibiina kuba abahiga empinduka, nk'emitwaro y'abantu erikukora, erikucwera haihi oburemeezi obu omu lujara, nukwo ab'obushoboorozi bashuubize, nk'eky'okureeberaho omutwaro gwa SOP (atarimu okucweera haihi obukuru bw'ebintu)."

question: Omuhendi ogwa "Emigisha n'okutsigamwa by'eteknologiya ery'obunaku obu", omwegyesa w'eteknologiya aha abaana ab'ekibiina abaha omurimo gw'okureeba, omu bihembe byabo, eby'okureeberaho by'okukora emirimo omu buringaaniza n'okumanya emigaruka yaabyo aha mbeera y'amagara y'abantu. Erimu aha mahanga lyakozire okucwekyereza kurungi, n'okuhuuza abantu n'okukora ebyahandiikwa aha itungo, nibareeba ekitebe ky'abakozi omu dduuka erimu ery'omunyololo y'amadduuka, ebi barikwenda nibirikwesigamizibwa aha kubura kw'emirimo ahabw'okukora emirimo omu buringaaniza bw'ebyoma by'okubara n'emirimo endiijo erikukwata aha kugaba n'okutwara ebintu. Eihanga nirikora okworeka kurungi munonga, niririkworeka okwetenga kubi kw'embeera abantu abu bahuuza. Okworeka kuherize, ki ki eki omwegyesa araakunde kworeka, kuha obuhabuzi bw'okukura omu murimo gw'eihanga, kyakuba nikirikukwatanisa n'ebirikwetengwa by'okwega omu musomo ogu?
answer_a: "Nimbashimire ahabw'okwejumba omu kubuurira obutonde bw'ensi obw'aha butaahi kandi nimbashaba kwetegyereza enyungu eziri omu mbeera egi: n'omugasho ki ogurikureetwa okukoresa emashini omu kuheereza abaguzi?"
answer_b: "Mureebire gye omukago gwanyu, mwashoboirwe gye kushuuruura aha nshonga y'ebirikurugamu omu kukoresa eby'obuhangwa. Omu kicweka ki ekindi ekirikureeta eby'omugasho eki orikuteekateeka ngu embeera nk'ezi zirikubaaho?"
answer_c: “Oihangire kurora ebirikukirira haihi ebirikworeka enshonga mbi ez’ebyentekonologia. Ninteekateeka ngu twine kukwataganya omugisha gwaitu ogurikukuraho n’ekyo: murimo ki murungi oguturikukora okutwariramu abataahi abarikwetenga kutoorana obundi bushobozi?”
answer_d: "Oihwereize kukora ebimanyiso by’omugasho muno kushuuruura ekimwe aha bigumire kwetantara ebirikuruga omu kukoresa obwengye bw’ekikoomi. Twaba nitumanya ekyo, bushaaza ki oburikwimukira abantu boona omu by’okuboneza abakozi abariho n’okwegyesa emirembe erikwija?"

question: Omwegyesi w’etekinoroji owa senteeri ey’abiri owa siniya, anyakugonza kutandika omulimo gw’omushinga, acwireho kukora okushwijuma okw’okubanza aha banyeshuri be kureeba obwengye n’okwetegyereza kwabo ebice by’omushinga, ebyabaire bimaze kwegyesibwa omwaka ogwahwaire. Twaba nitureeba ekigyendererwa n’ebirikushwijumwa, ni ki aha bikoreso ebi eby’okushwijuma ekirikukwata gye?
answer_a: Ebirango eby'omukoro gw'ebitekerezo ebirukirayo omu isomo aha bikorwa ebirikukorwa omu buri kicweka ky'omushinga
answer_b: Orutindo orurikwetengwa okubaamu ebintu ebirikworeka omutindo ogushemereire kubaamu omu kubumbabumba buri kimwe aha bitundu by'omushinga kandi erikubasisa kubyetegyereza omu mirimo egiirikukorwa.
answer_c: Ekibuuzo ekihandiikirwe ekirimu ebibuuzo eby'okugarukamu ebirikugambira, omu kuheebwa omushonga, orikumanya ebiceera by'omushinga ebirikushaanisa kandi ohabure eby'okugarukamu byawe.
answer_d: Rubriki y’okushobora omurimo erimu ebikaguzo by’emitendera y’obuhangwa bw’obwengye eyorikworeka omu mitendera y’omushinga, nk’oku barikukura buri omwe omuri omurimo gw’ekibiina

question: Abanyeshuri abarikwega omu mashomero ga secondary bari omu mutendera gw'okutebeekanisa omurimo gwabo. Kureetera abanyeshuri kutebeekanisa, omwegyesa acwireho kumara eshaaha y'okwegyesa nibega oku bakora n'ebishushani bya PERT, omubwo baine kuteeraho emikwatane y'emirimo y'okubuurira omurimo gwabo. Aha muheru gw'eshaaha y'okwegyesa, omwegyesa acwireho kucungura okwetegyereza kw'abanyeshuri aha bishushani ebi n'omugasho gwabyo, ahabw'okuhindura entebeekanisa y'eshaaha erikukuraho kurugiirira aha by'abanyeshuri barikugarukamu. Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, niki ekirikwija kureetera omwegyesa kwongyera kwetegyereza ebi abanyeshuri barikumanya n'omugasho gw'ebishushani bya PERT?
answer_a: Omukura gw'okwebuuza omunywani, omu abanywani barikwebuuza, "Okwombeka ekishushani kya PERT nikikora kita," hanyuma bakareetera hamwe eby'okugarukamu byabo.
answer_b: Ekitabo ky'okushohora, kuragiira abeeshuri kworeka ebintu bishatu ebi beegire omu ishomo n'ebibuuzo bibiri ebi bakyaineho aha bikwatiraine n'ebishushani bya PERT n'omugasho gwabyo
answer_c: Omugyereso gw'okushabuurira okwetegyereza, hamwe n'okugabura omulingo abeeshuri barikwetegyereza kurugiirira aha by'abashubize omu kibuzo eki: “Ekishushani kya PERT niki?”
answer_d: Orubazo rw'ebibuuzo ahu abeeshuri baine kugarukamu eki baayegireho aha bikwaata aha dayaguraamu ya PERT n'eki erikukoresibwa, kurugiirira aha mitwaro egi: "Ninkimanya gye; Nimanya, kwonka tindikubaasa kukishoboorora; kandi tindikumanya"

question: Omuhereza w’ekicweka, omwegyesa w’ekumi n’omwe arashomesa abegi be aha bigyendererwa by’okwega ebi: “Kwetegyereza n’okukuza okucwamu okw’amaani aha miringo y’eby’obuhangwa ekoresibwa omuri Chile kutunga n’okuhindura amaani”. Ebikorwa ebiri aha hansi ebihe byarugiraho byabaasa kworeka omulingo abegi batungireho ekigyendererwa ky’ekicweka?
answer_a: Mugambire abeeshuri kworeka omuzano ogurikworeka ebirikurugamu omu miringo y'okuzaara n'okuhereza amaani omu ihanga.
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa bakore taabulo erimu ebi abantu abamanyirwe baroza aha migasho n'obubi bw'emitwarize etari emwe ey'okutunga n'okuhindura amaani ebi baayegire.
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesa bakore akapande akarikworeka emyemerero etari emwe y’ebitongore by’ensi yoona aha bikwatiraine n’okutunga n’okuhindura amaani omu miringo ekoresibwa omu ihanga.
answer_d: Shaba abeshomi bandiike ekyenda kyabo hamu n'enshonga ibiri ezirikukwata aha mazima n'obubi bw'omuringo gumwe gw'okuzaara amaani ogu mweegaire.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omu mwaka ogwa ikumi n’ababii abegyeswa be kukora okunoonyereza aha bukugu omu kukoresa obutare bw’amaani. Eikundi rimwe nirireeta omusango ogurikugira ngu eby’omugasho ebirikukoresa amashanyarazi makye nibyo birikukora gye, eki kitarikuhikaana n’omuringo eby’omugasho ebi birikutebeekwa omu meza y’obukugu bw’amaani.
Kiki ekirikubaasa kuba nikizibuura abegyeswa omu mbeera eyo ereetsirwe?
answer_a: Nibagira aha bw’amaani g’amaisho g’ebyoma ebirikukoresa amaani agatarimu g’obumanyire.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza omuringo gw'amaani g'omugasho n'okukoresa amaani makye omu bikoreso ebi bikora omulimo gumwe.
answer_c: Nibamanya omugasho gw'amaani nk'okukendeeza amaani, batarikuteekateeka ngu omulimo rundi obuhereza oburikukorwa eby'omugasho nibumwe.
answer_d: Nibamanyisa omuringo gw'amaani gukora gye nk'okwerinda okukoresa amaani mabi omu kukora omurimo nari okuheereza kw'ebikoreso ebirikwetegyerezebwa.

question: Omutwe gw'abanyeshuri abari omu mwaka gwabo ogw'okubanza omu mashomero g'ahaiguru bagambiire abarikwija kuheereza omurimo gw'eby'omukono (banywani baabo abarikushoma nabo) abu barikuza kuheereza omurimo gw'eby'omukono. Baataireho okucweeza n'abanywani baabo abarikushoma nabo kandi bashanga ngu ekirikwetagisa munonga n'okukora sente z'okugyenda omu rugyendo rw'aha muheru gw'omwaka. Omwegyesa abagira ngu hati nibashemeza omurongo gw'okumaraho ekyetengo eki barikwenda. Kurugiirira aha muringo gw'omurimo, niki aha miringo egi omwegyesa ashemereire kuba yaakozireho kare kubaasa kwanguhya omurimo ogu baataireho?
answer_a: Geranisiza enshonga ezirikukora nk'omugasho gumu, noobahwereza kwetaho emitero etari emwe, reero oyerondereeza omucwecumwe kandi oguhe obuhame.
answer_b: Shuuruurana n'abeeshuri, musheruremu ebyarugire omu kubuuzibwa kw'abantu okuhameeza ekyetengo ekimanyirwe eky'okutaho orukurato rw'obuhereza
answer_c: Teekanisa omuringo gw'okuheereza, orikwebembera abeeshuri kugarukamu ebi ekyetengo ekimazire kuteerwawo kirikwenda n'abarikwakiikirirwa
answer_d: Tebeekanisa emirimo egirikwetagisa omu kuza omuhendo ogu, kuhwera abeeshuri kworeka omuruuru gw'emirimo, ebintu ebirikwetagisa n'obwire, hamu n'obwomeezi oburikwetagisa.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’abiri owa siniya eshuro orikutebeekanisa eicweka ry’okwega arikugira ekigyendererwa "Kushobora ebirikubaasa kubaho eby’omugasho nari ebitarikumara gye ebirikuruga omu bintu ebirikuhangwa obwahati omu by’obuntu, obutare, eby’obutonde, amateeka, eby’obushubuzi, nari omu bindi." Aha ক্লাসি ey’okubanza, nibaija kukurata ekigyendererwa ky’okwega eki: "Kuteebereza ebirugire omu bintu ebyahangirweho enyima."
Omu mirimo ei erikukurataho, niki ekirikubaasa kureka omwegyesa kukora aha kigyendererwa eki arikwija kukoraho omu ক্লাসি ey’okubanza?
answer_a: Yoreka abegyeshuri vidiyo erikworeka okuhangwa n’okukura kw’ebintu by’eteknologi ez’omutaano hamwe n’omugasho ebi birikuuga omu bantu b’omuri obu bwire, reero obagambire kworeka ebi birikugira omugasho mubi munonga.
answer_b: Shoborora abeeshuri emigasho mirungi n'emibi y'ekampasi, reero obagambire banoonyere ebintu ebindi ebirukozesezebwa ebirukwataine n'emigasho nk'egyo.
answer_c: Yoreka abegyeshuri vidiyo erikukwata aha mashini y'omwika n'oku yaakuzire yaaba ebindi by'okuhanga. Hanyuma obabuze kwatura emigisha ei ereetsire omu bwire oburikugyenda nirukura.
answer_d: Yoreka abegyeshuri okukurakulana kw'ekintu ky'omulembe omusya nk'entelefoni, n'oku kyakozesezebwa omu bantu b'omulembe ogu. Bwanyima obagambire kwijuza akacweka akabarukugaragaza emigasho n'obubi bwako.

question:
Omuhendiisa yaatandika omutwe "Okureetera omugasho omu bikoresho byaitu" n'ekibiina ky'abanyeshuri abali omu mwaka gwakabiri omu mashomero agari haihi, omugyezaho naatandika okugamba n'ekibiina kuraba omu kibuzo ekirikugyema: "Nitubaasa tuta kuba abantu b'omu by'oburezi abarikukwata omu maisho okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa okurikukuumwa?" Buli munyeshuri naahandiika ekiteekerezo kye aha kaadi yaaba nayita omu kikaati, yaagiteeka aha kabaho akarikukoresibwa ahabw'ekigyendererwa eki. Enkaadi zirimu emigasho eshatu y'ebiteekerezo: emitwarize erikukwata aha kutereeka amaizi n'amashanyarazi, ebiteekerezo by'okugaruramu ebintu ebirikukoresibwa, n'okukora engyeso z'okuceeya okukoresa pulasitiiki. Ahabw'okukoresa obumwe obwo obw'omugasho gw'okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa okurikukuumwa, omugyezaho naacwamu kukora omurimo n'abanyeshuri be kubareetera kwongyera n'okuhurikiza okwetegyereza kwabo aha izooba eryo.
Ni engyeso ki aha zirikukurataho eyaaba neyoreka omugyezaho kworeka gye omugasho gw'okukura kw'eby'obuhangwa okurikukuumwa?
answer_a: Mureke abeeshumi bareebere embeera y'obucureezi: okuremesa amashanyarazi kumara eshaaha mukaaga buri izooba nk'omuringo gw'okukendeeza amaani. Bashaashuure omu bibinja emigashe y'omuringo ogu aha butonde bw'ensi, eby'obushubuzi, n'enzigyirizo z'embeera z'abantu ezitari zimwe. Aha muheru, bacweere orubanza aha mugashe gw'enfundo nk'ezi.
answer_b: Yoreka abeshomesha vidiyo erikwetwa "Akabi k'Ensi" kandi obahiga kugamba aha migisha egi okukara kw'ensi kwaleeta omu bice by'obwomeezi ebihendaanhenda aha nsi: ebintu ebirukwata aha bwomeezi bw'ebiramu, obwingi bw'amaizi, eby'obuhangwa ebirikutaahirira, n'ebindi. Nibateekateeka engyeso z'okuceereza ebirikurugamu omu migisha egi etungwire.
answer_c: Shaba abeeshuri bashwijume ebyahandiikirwe, amaripooti, n'amakanisa agamba aha mpaka z'obutare n'eby'obuhangwa eziriho omu kitundu eki eshuro eri, reero bateebereze enshonga yazireeta kurugiirira aha bitebeeryo binu: eby'obureezi, eby'obushomesha, n'eby'obufuzi.
answer_d: Hamwe n'abeshuri, mukore orutonde rw'emitwarize eyoraabe nebazireeta omu itungo ry'abantu, erikwija kuhwera omu kukora emirimo ei erikwija kworekwa aha kaadi. Reero, mukore okweyeshoma nk'eklassi, mureebe ebi mutarikukora gye, mureebe oku murikubaasa kubihindura.

question: Omugyezibwa w’etekinologia naakora ebiragiro by’omukura gw’okunoonyereza oguraakolebwa abegyeki b’omwaka ogw’okubanza omu mashomero g’ahaiguru nk’ekicweka ky’ekicweka “Enkurakurana n’omugasho gw’omucwecuro.” Omukura guraaba gwesigamiize aha murimo oguraatorwa buri kibinja ogu baraanoonyereza aha nkurakurana eguutooraine omu myaka makumi agaherize, hamu n’okuteekateeka aha bintu ebirikwetengwa n’omugasho gw’enkuraakurana egi. Kureetera omutindo gw’eby’omugasho gw’enshonga y’okuhiga okuteekateeka kw’amaani, ni bibuuzo ki ebirikukwata aha nshonga eziine kukwata aha mukura gw’omurimo?
answer_a: Ni nshonga ki ezirikukwata aha mbeera y'abantu ezareeteire enkyukakkyuka omu muringo ogu eby'omugasho birikukorwamu? Yoreka omugasho gwa buri kamwe aha nkyukakkyuka y'omuringo ogu ogw'obuhangwa bw'omuntu.
answer_b: Omu nsi yoona, orikuteekateeka ngu okuhinduka kw'enkora y'okukora ebintu nikureetera omuringo murungi gw'okumaraho ekyetengo eki erikumaraho? Hikiriza eky'orikuteekateeka n'eby'okureeberaho ebi orikureeba buri izooba.
answer_c: Kurugiire ebyarondoirwe omu purojekiti egi, mbwenu emigisha nari obubi nibyo birukirayo omu kuzaana kw'obuhereza obu? Hikiriza eby'orikugarukamu orikukoresa eby'obusingye, eby'obutonde bw'ensi, n'eby'obushubuzi.
answer_d: Ni nshonga ki ezi orikubaasa kukora iwe nk'omuntu hamwe n'abantu abandi omu itungo ry'abantu kugira ngu ogyezaho kuremesa ebirikubaasa kuruga omu kuhendera kw'ebintu? Taaha ebintu bibiri byona ebi orikubaasa kukora hamwe n'omugasho gwabyo.

question: Omugyezibwa ki ogurikukurira aha hansi ogwabaasa kwikiriza omwegyesa kwegendereza ekigyendererwa ekiragwire n’okugarukamu okukomerezibwa kw’omurongo gw’ebitekerezo ebirikwetenga obwengye?
answer_a: Gyenda abeeshuli abakozeseze obwato bw'aha bwaizi bwa gavumenti bagambire abanywani baabo ebi baraabe bahikireho, reero obatebeekanisize omu tubinja tutono kwetegyereza obukuru bw'okwoleka emiteekateeka mirungi omu kukozesa obwato bw'omutaano obu n'omumigisha ebi okubukozesa kurikubaasa kugira aha butonde bw'ensi n'aha bantu.
answer_b: Yoreka abegyeshuri vidiyo erikworeka abagaisi nibakoresa ebigyezi omu muringo ogutari murungi, nibasharika enguuto batarikugondera ebimanyiso nari etaraaza z'enguuto, hamwe n'okugaara ebigaali bataine ngufuuza nari etabaaza. Obagambire kutoorana ekizibu kimwe eki bareebire, bateebere emigarukiro yaakyo, reero bashabe ebiteekateeko by'okuceeceereza emigarukiro egyo.
answer_c: Yenda abeeshuri bareebe omu kasozi emigisha n'ebizibu ebiruga omu kuteeka amagare g'abantu boona omu myanya etari emwe nka aha makubo, omu parki, n'aha miryango y'omutindo gw'omunsi. Hanyuma obagambire batebeekane ebyo bareebire, nukwo barugyemu baze omumaisho n'okushaba enshonga z'okumaraho ebizibu ebyo.
answer_d: Mubuurize abeeshuri kubuuza ab’eka yaabo n’abamanyirizi baabo okuhandiika oku bahungwire nari oku bakozeseze ebirungi by’e service y’engaaari ya gavumenti. Bwanyima, mubeegyeise ebitebeekanisiibwe kurugiirira aha bitegyererezo ebi baashobora kwetegyereza omu bice by’omutaano (eby’obusinge, eby’obutonde, eby’eby’obushubuzi, n’ebindi), batebeekanise ebirugiremu, kandi baze omu class bagambe eki barikuteekateeka aha service n’obuhame.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa sekenda ari kukora n'abegyi be aha mutwe gw'ekyegyeso "Emigisha n'Okusoomooza by'Eby'omugisha by'Obuhangwa bwa Technology Ebiro Ebi" kandi ari kugarukamu ebi abegyi bakozire omu kutandika. Obu barikugaba eby'okugarukamu byabo, okukoresa ekigambo "okugaruramu" nikigarukwamu emirundi mingi kumanyisa omurimo gwona ogurikukwata aha kukoresa ekintu kya technology ekikozirwe. Kubaasa kwihaho okutangara oku, omwegyesa naatebeekanisa eby'okureeberaho bibiri bibiri kubaasa kuhwera abegyi kumanya enshonga y'okugaruramu n'okukoresa omurundi ogundi.
Eby'okureeberaho bishana ebiri eby'okugaruramu n'okukoresa omurundi ogundi, ebiri ahansi aha, nibihwera abegyi kumanya gye enshonga eri hagati y'ebigambo ebi?
answer_a: Hinda omumuringo gw'okukoresa ebintu ebirikushangwa nibitwarwa nk'eby'entaaho, nk'okurema ebintu ebirikuterera amakanisa g'ebyokunywa, n'okuhindura ekintu, nk'okuhindura eccupa ya pulasitiki kukirema akacupa akitira.
answer_b: Koresa empapura aha mbaju zombi reero ogite omu byombo ebiri omu myanya erikusiimirwa omu kaaro, kandi oreetere akaahu kawe omu supaamaakeeti, obuteetenga akahu kasya.
answer_c: Kora omushubyo gw'ebimera orikuruga omu bisusumbo by'ebyokurya, nk'ebishishwa by'ebijanja na nyabwo z'emboga, kandi okoreshe eby'okukoresa omu muringo ogurikukirayo obwingi kurabira omu kwongyera omuhendo gw'oku bikoresa.
answer_d: Okutegyereza n'okuhindura ebicupa by'endiro omu ndabirwamu nari za vase, n'okuha abantu abandi ebyambaro ebitakikozesibwa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’eky’omukaaga, okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa: "Okwombeka ebishushani by’ebintu kuhikiiriza ebizibu", naija kwegyesa abegyirwa be kukoresa emiringo eshatu (omurongo ogw’ahaiguru/omumaiso, orubaju, n’enteekaniza) nukwo bashobore kubikoresa omu kwoleka ekintu ky’obuhangwa aha mutindo ogucumireho ogwa 1:10. Orukurato rw’emirimo oruha oruraija kuleetera abegyirwa kwegyerereza haihi kwega ebirimu ebi n’okubikoresa?
answer_a: Mubone ebimanyiso by'okubonerera aha Powerpoint ebirikworeka emiringo eshatu ey'ekintu. Obuuze abeeshuri: Okushushana ekintu kuraba omu miringo egi nikuhereza amakuru aha bicweka byakyo, nikibaasa kukora? Bahe ekintu eki baraashushane, orondereho omuringo gumwe. Baireke kumanya oku barikukoresa akafumu k'okupima, ngu babease kukoresa omu muringo ogu barikwenda kukora.
answer_b: Ha mbeera ebishushani 3 by'ekintu kimwe n'enyimaisho zaakyo 3; ekishushani kimwe na kimwe kibeine ebipimo by'amazima by'ekintu ekyo ebirikworekwa. Ohemu orupapura orugaburiranwe, orwine omwanya gwa buri nyimaisho, ahu abeeshuri baraayegyerereze buri kishushani, barikubiteeka omu mitwaro yaabyo. Yegyesa okucweeka ebipimo omu mulingo gwa 1:10 orikuraba omu by'okureeberaho ebirikukwata aha nshonga aha bbaaho, orikukora okubala okurikukwatana nako.
answer_c: Yoreka vidiyo erikworeka eby'okureeberera ebirooto 3 eby'ekintu. Leeta ebintu by'omutekano by'entaano omu kiraasi abeeshuri bashobore kupima obureingwa bwabyo n'omufumo. Yoreka aha bbaoodi okuhingura okucweeka okuruga omu bipimo ebi baahandiika. Koresa empapura y'ebigrafi okushushana emishwi eshatu: X, Y, Z, buri gumwe yaaba neyetantaza 30°, reero obegyese okuza omuntu omuhanda gw'okureeberera ekintu kyabo.
answer_d: Yoreka vidiyo erikushoborora emiringo eshatu ey'okureeba ekintu. Obuuze abeeshuri: okwolekwa kw'ekintu kuraba omu miringo egi nikukuha amahurire aha bicweka byakyo? Bahe ebintu byangu kweshushura emiringo yaabyo. Okwegyesa okucumya ebipimo, yoreka orikukoresa kimwe aha bintu ebi ohaire aha rupapura rw'ebigarama, orikukoresa omufumo, set square, na T-square.

question: Omwegyesereza w’ekicweka kya munaana ari kutandika omurimo n’abegi be aine ekigyendererwa ky’okuheereza abakuru abari omu ka eyombekirwe eshomero. Eki, omu kicweka eki, nibenda kukora okukusanya amakuru ahari abantu abarikugyenda omu ka n’ebyetago byabo. Aha mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikubaasa kwegyesa abegi kumanya ebyetago by’abantu?
answer_a: Yombeka omuti gw'ebizibu kworeka embeera mbi, nobukuru bw'ebirikubiteera n'ebirikurugamu.
answer_b: Geranisiriza engyenderwaho ez'omukukorera hamwe n'okucweekereza ebiragiro nk'okubuuza abantu n'okubaha ebipapura by'okuzamuza, reero oteekeho emigasho yaabyo n'obubi bwaabyo.
answer_c: Shuuruza eky'omutwaro gwa SWOT ohingure omugasho gw'ekishushani, oronde ebirikukomeza amaani, emigisha, obulemi n'obutiinisa.
answer_d: Teekateekateeka oburemeezi oburikubaasa kuba nibubataataaganya, reero ocondooreze emiringo y'okuzaanira amakuru.

question: Omuhwezi omu iraaya ry'omunaana, omu isomo ry'okubanza ery'omutwe ogurikukwata aha Bintu by'Obuhangwa n'Eby'Etekinologia Ebikora Gye kandi Ebireetera Obusingye, omwegyesa atandika arikushoboorora ekirikwetwa obusingye. Kugasira abegi kwetegyereza, omwegyesa acwireho kukishoboorora ahabw'eky'okureeberaho. Niki eky'okureeberaho eki omwegyesa araabe asaasiire kugasira abegi kwetegyereza obusingye?
answer_a: Omu omuhanda, nibateeka eky'omugati kya noodles aha ky'omuro gwa nyenkyakare owa abantu bana. Abantu bashatu bonka nibo batuura kuliya kandi, ahabw'okuba baine enjara nyingi, baliya noodles zoona. Omuntu owaabaire abuzire ku araize, ab'eka nibakoresa amaani n'amaizi bw'okubanza bateeke noodles endiijo ahabw'omuntu owaabaire abuzire.
answer_b: Omurimi w’akaaya akacureezi arikusimburana okutandisa emboga ezitari zimwe ezirikwetenga emiringo etari emwe, nk’enyanya, karooti, n’amatooke omwaka gumwe, n’obushaza, ebitunguru, n’ebitoogo omwaka ogurikukuraho, ahabw’okugumya itaka kuba rirungi ahabw’ebirimwa by’omumaisho.
answer_c: Omwegyeshuri ashohoreire esimu erimu amaani make, yaatandika kugichajiinga. Obwo obwo, yaatandika kucweka omuzano, kwonka omuzano nigumara amaani g'esimu bwangu okukira encharja eri kugijuzamu. N'ekirikurugamu, esimu neija kuzima bwanyima y'obwire bukye, n'ahabw'ekyo omwegyeshuri ahindura encarjya erikwijuzamu bwangu.
answer_d: Omukozi w’emeeza narukora meeza omu muringo ogurikworeka ngu obwaraaba nasara ebice by’emeeza kuruga omu mbaaho, akoresa embaaho yoona kandi ebice ebirikushigara nabikoresa omu miringo endiijo, akikyendeza omuhendo gw’ebikoreso ebirikukoresibwa kandi n’akuzaho omuringo ogu gw’okukora nk’akamanyiso k’ekicweka kye okwongyera okutunda.

question: Omugwi gw'abanyeshuri nibakora omutaano gw'eby'omugasho ogw'ekikoranwa omukukora emirimo y'okuriisa ebinywanwa, ekyetengo eki kikazurwa ahabw'okuba omwe aha banyeshuri akasiiga ekinywanwa kye kyonka omu izooba. Kurugiirira aha mbeera erikugambwaho, niki aha bikurikukuratira omwegyesa arikubaasa kukora kworeka abanyeshuri omu kicweka eki ky'omushinga?
answer_a: Shwijuma omuringo gw'ekikorwa ky'eteknologiya eki abeeshuri b'omutwe bagambiire.
answer_b: Shoborora ebirikukwata aha kuhangwa kw'ekintu, abeeshuri bamanye oku baraayombeka ekikorwa kyabo eky'eteknologiya.
answer_c: Haandi ebi orabeireho omu maanisho g'okugyenda omu maisho omu kuzooba ekikorwa ky'eteknologiya kurugiirira aha kuteekateeka kw'ekitabo ky'ekibiina eki baahandiikairemu ebi baakozire.
answer_d:
